name: Startup Savant

sources.title: Startup Savant advertising page — sponsored editorial packages
Startup Savant media kit (Branded Guide and Spotlight Feature)
Third-party guide claiming a free submission form exists (unverified)

requirements: The site's own advertise page offers only sponsored editorial packages written by their team: 'Spotlight Feature' (profile article about you/your company, $3,750) and 'Branded Guide' (topic article with brand mention)
Every sponsored piece is written by Startup Savant's editorial team, not submitted by you
They respond within 3-5 business days 'if your inquiry is a good fit' — selectivity applies even to paid placements
preparation: Budget approval — Spotlight Feature is listed at $3,750; Branded Guide pricing in the media kit
A brief describing your business, audience and goals
For Spotlight: availability for an interview with their editorial team
Company details for the contact form
workflow: Fill in the contact form or email to inquire
If accepted, align on topic/angle/deliverables with their team
Their writers produce the article; you get draft review with one round of revisions
Article publishes on the Startup Savant News section with newsletter + social promotion; FTC-compliant sponsored labeling applied
watchFor: Third-party directory guides claim free submissions exist — the current site shows no free listing path; treat free-route claims as stale
All placements carry FTC-compliant sponsored labeling — no disguised editorial
Only one round of revisions is included
12-month minimum live guarantee — but confirm removal terms after that period
countsAsLive: A published article on startupsavant.com (News section) about or featuring the company
unknowns: Branded Guide exact price (media kit says 'for pricing visit /advertise' — Spotlight is $3,750)
Whether any genuinely free submission/listing route survives
Whether links in sponsored articles are dofollow or carry rel=sponsored
Current turnaround from inquiry to publication
